briefTitle: Feasibility of Addressing Sexual Dysfunction in Women with Breast and Gynecologic Cancers with a Novel Mobile Application
officialTitle: Not Always ROSY-Feasibility of Addressing Sexual Dysfunction in Women with Breast and Gynecologic Cancers with a Novel Mobile Application

eligibility.text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient with a current or historic diagnosis of breast cancer or gynecologic cancer (uterine ovarian, fallopian tube, peritoneal, cervical, vulva, or vaginal cancers)
* Agree to participate in the study with completion of survey and use of ROSY mobile application

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently pregnant
* Non-English speaking (ROSY is currently is only available is in English).
